education.description: Sichuan Agricultural University (SAU), or “Chuan Nong Da” for short, is co-sponsored by the Ministry of Education of the PRC and the People’s Government of Sichuan Province. It is listed in the “Double First-Class” initiative and the “211 Project” and is renowned for its distinct disciplines and agricultural strengths. The university’s Department of Computer Science, supported by platforms such as the “Agricultural Information Engineering Laboratory”, focuses its teaching and research on smart agriculture, agricultural big-data and digital-village development, forging an interdisciplinary edge that combines computing technologies with agricultural applications.
